subject: Re: Sign-off: open public API endpoints for DataBridge
body: Taylor — thanks for the nudge. To be precise: Option A (from earlier in this thread) is native OAuth + scoped public endpoints. Architect capacity for that path is tight through Insights v2, so I'm not ready to commit to A this sprint. Let's park on Option B (partner webhook) as the interim path and revisit native OAuth once launch lands. I'll confirm marketplace featuring separately.
